quotes.text:
But sike fancies weren foolerie,
And broughten this Oake to this miserye.
quotes.reference: 1579, Immeritô [pseudonym; Edmund Spenser], The Shepheardes Calender: […], London: […] Hugh Singleton, […], →OCLC:

quotes.text:
Therein an hundred raunges weren pight,
And hundred fornaces all burning bright;
quotes.reference: 1590, Edmund Spenser, “Book II, Canto VII”, in The Faerie Queene. […], London: […] [John Wolfe] for William Ponsonbie, →OCLC:

quotes.text:
For of the falsé Moabites
Forth with the strength of Amonites
Of that they weren first misget,
quotes.reference: 1889, John Gower, edited by Henry Morley, Tales of the Seven Deadly Sins: Being the Confessio Amantis:
